results.prop: B2C-S2 conditional admission within 9.0 s in the abstract two-claimant model
results.formula: bounded delivery and feasible concession/admission -> higher-priority vehicle admitted by the horizon
results.note: Two concurrent unadmitted claimants; the winner holds the loser's claim and remains committed without any other claimant. The loser is calm, unadmitted and robustly upstream when it receives the winner's fresh claim. The winner receives the truthful withdrawal. At the deadline all remaining local admission guards are true, including healthy, quiet FRONT, validated localization, no possible occupant and a fresh report. The deadline is measured from concurrent commitment with the winner already holding the loser's claim. Once admitted, clearance additionally requires Pi2. This model does not establish the delivery or physical premises.
